config_snapshot: Task issue #829: [ T3 Code ] Implement automatic token refresh in ACP client with Effect retry. Requirements loaded before implementation: add token expiry detection in the ACP client by checking response status for 401 Unauthorized; implement automatic re-authentication flow using Effect.retry with a custom schedule that attempts re-auth once before failing; store refresh token separately from access token in client state; add an onSessionExpired callback in client options that fires before re-authentication to allow custom handling; wrap retry logic in Effect.acquireRelease to ensure old session is properly cleaned up before creating a new one. Acceptance criteria: 401 responses trigger automatic re-authentication without user intervention; retry schedule attempts re-auth exactly once before propagating error; refresh token is stored and used for re-authentication; onSessionExpired callback fires with expired session ID before re-auth; Effect.acquireRelease properly cleans up old session resources; concurrent requests during re-auth are queued and replayed after new session is established; if re-auth fails, all queued requests fail with typed AuthenticationError; tests use Effect.TestContext to simulate session expiry and re-auth flows; include agent name and [ T3 Code ] in PR title; changes include a .provenance.json file in the modified directory with agent_name, config_snapshot, and created.
